create_pathmanager: create a project-specific PathManager instance to manage file I/O without conflicting with fvcore's global PathManager
register_detectron2_handler: register a Detectron2Handler to resolve paths prefixed with detectron2:// from dl.fbaipublicfiles.com
register_http_handler: register an HTTPURLHandler to support opening files from HTTP URLs via PathManager
register_onedrive_handler: register a OneDrivePathHandler to support opening files from OneDrive URLs via PathManager
open_detectron2_path: open a detectron2:// URL by resolving it to the corresponding S3 URL and returning a file handle
